note: The oracle writes a datasheet page for a real part of the seeded project in this style from the part's own library symbol (correct twin), and a copy with one random pin renamed (true rename).
split: A15: number-first, multi-function, ordering-code-note visible; the rest owner-held

styles.doc: Plain number-first pin table, one name per cell.
Each cell lists several functions, the symbol's name is NOT the first one: '<ALT1> / <ALT2> (<NAME>)'.
The table shows a default function; a numbered note says that for this ordering code the pin is <NAME> (the W25Q -IQ case).
